name: static_evaluator
description: Static code review for correctness, credential flow, and behavioral contracts.

unmappedExclusions.planframe_*: no dsh analog (durable workflow plans are not a tool surface)
unmappedExclusions.scheduler_*: schedule_create/delete/list are not mounted in the standard composition
unmappedExclusions.workflow_*: no dsh analog (durable workflow state/query tools are not a dsh surface)
unmappedExclusions.credential_*: dsh resolves credentials per-operation (CredentialRef), no model-facing tool
unmappedExclusions.wiki_*: no dsh analog (knowledge plane deferred by the port plan)
unmappedExclusions.capsule_*: Phase 7 machinery — no dsh tool yet
unmappedExclusions.admin_proposal_*: Phase 8 amendment machinery — no dsh tool yet
unmappedExclusions.session_*: session query is host-side, not a model-facing tool
unmappedExclusions.sentinel_*: ported as CI-side gates, not model-facing tools
unmappedExclusions.constitution_*: the constitution is a service, not a tool
unmappedExclusions.sandbox_exec: on dsh the sandboxed bash tool IS the confined executor; mount cures ride sandbox_request_mount, which stays granted
unmappedExclusions.agent_list: no dsh analog (roster inspection is host-side, not a model-facing tool)
